Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game! A run-fest is what we witnessed and we can expect no different from the last game which now turns out to be a must-win for the hosts. That match will be played on the 16th of this month at 1430 local (1230 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

MAN OF THE MATCH AND Pakistan skipper, Babar Azam, says he was waiting for such an innings, he had this planned and it came off today. States he plays to his strength and he tries to play as the team needs him to. Credits Rizwan for the way he played and he actually boosts the morale of the side. Admits the dream of being the number ODI batsman was a dream and it came off today and he tries to improve everyday. Tells that the first six overs is being played well by the South African batters but he credits the bowlers for their comeback towards the end.

South African captain, Heinrich Klaasen, says it is tough to explain, he felt he was about 10 runs short and they lost momentum at the back end. Credits Pakistan for the way they batted, they made a lot of good balls look bat and they were poor in the field. Adds there is a lot to think about and they need to bounce back strongly. Mentions they have played a lot of cricket at this stadium and he knows 200 is not enough as it is not an easy ground to defend, they needed to be at their best in the field but that was not the case and they were not complacent. Also says if you bowl well, 210-220 would have been par. Ends by saying they need someone to go on a big one after getting past fifty and that is where they need to improve.

Earlier in the day, after electing to bowl, the Pakistan bowlers took a pounding. A very good opening stand saw the foundation laid for a big score for the hosts. They did not end well with the bat but still managed to get over 200. That though was chased without breaking a sweat as Pakistan's skipper, along with Rizwan rose to the occasion.

The South African bowling was not at its best, the bowlers were short, width was offered which made batting very easy on a wicket which was already favoring the batters. Yes, it is not easy conditions to bowl in but the bowling was also poor. The fielding did not help either as there were a few run out chances which were not taken and a dropped catch too. South Africa were qutie off color in the field in this game.

They took the initial two overs to get their eye in but once they did, they tonked the ball to every corner of the park. Especially Azam who was hitting boundaries at will. Rizwan was happy to play second fiddle and he did it brilliantly. The skipper scored a ton and his partner scored a half ton. Just as it seemed like, they would record a 10-wicket win, Azam fell right at the end. However, that was a thumping win.

What a win that is! A mockery was made of 204! Not often do we get to write that but that is the case! Yes, the wicket is as flat as one can get and the ground is small but you have to bat really well while chasing 204 and the Pakistan openers have done it brilliantly.
FOUR! Smashed away! Zaman hits the winning runs! It is full and on off, it is powered down to the long off fence. PAKISTAN WIN BY 9 WICKETS AND WITH TWO OVERS TO GO!
FOUR! Just the three needed now! Shorter and outside off, Zaman looks to push at it but it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.

OUT! TAKEN! South Africa finally get a wicket. End of a once in a lifetime innings! A masterclass! The hosts' players walk up to Azam and congratulate him as he walks off. This has been special. Not the best of balls to get him but Lizaad will be delighted he has a wicket and has not given a 10-wicket win to Pakistan. This is short and down the leg side. Azam looks to pull, it goes off the glove and to the keeper who takes it.
Shorter and on the pads, this is worked towards fine leg for one more.
Azam now plays it down to third man for one.
Shorter and on off, the upper cut is played down to third man for one.
A full toss, Rizwan only manages to work it towards deep square leg for one. 10 needed now.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Just the two hits away now! On middle, this is worked wide of long on for one.

FOUR! That is outrageous! Wow! How has he got that down there? What a player! This is a yorker on middle and leg. Azam gets his front leg out of the way and then jams it out fine on the off side to the third man fence.
FOUR! Full toss, a batsman batting on over 100 won't miss out. It is hit wide of long on.
A full toss, it is hit down to long on for one.
This is worked down to long on for one.
Well fielded! Rizwan goes down on one knee and plays it over short fine leg. Magala runs and keeps it down to two.
On middle, this is hit down to long on for two.
Outside off, Rizwan fails to put bat on ball.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Outside off, this is carved over point for a boundary.
A single to end as this is pushed through covers.
FOUR! He wants to finish this quickly now! This is on the pads, it is swept behind square on the leg side. Another boundary.

FOUR! 100 for Azam! A huge roar from him as he sees the ball getting to the fence. What a knock! Talk about rising to the occasion! Under pressure, must-win game, chasing a big score and the skipper ends up scoring his first T20I ton. Superb! This is tossed up outside off, it is hit through covers. Boundary.
Wide! Down the leg side, wided.
SIX! Onto 96 now! Azam making this look very easy now! This is shorter and on middle, it is pulled over mid-wicket for a biggie.
In the air... safe again! On middle, Rizwan looks to play the slog sweep. The top edge is induced but it lands short in the mid-wicket region. One taken.
FOUR! Poor start by Shamsi! And Pakistan now doing it in a canter! This is shorter and on the body, Rizwan pulls it over short fine leg. Boundary.
Outside off, Rizwan guides it to point for one. The 150 is p and this is an outstanding partnership. Take a bow, both of you.

Half a chance again but not taken! An overthrow in the end! Outside off, this is guided towards point. They go for one. The fielder has a shy but misses. The fielder backing up is in the deep. A single taken.
FOUR! That is a magical shot! Makes room, Hendricks bowls it full and outside off. It is lofted over covers. Boundary.
A single now as this is worked through mid-wicket.
SIX! Adding salt to the wound! Stand and deliver! Short and on middle, Azam stands tall and heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.

Dropped! Van Bijon was the culprit and that was a sitter! Need to take these, especially when you are chasing the game. A short one outside off. Hendricks looks to upper cut it. It goes off the splice towards backward point. The fielder moves that side and looks to take it but spills it. A single in the end.
Two is the call again but just one! On the pads, this is worked towards deep mid-wicket. One taken. 69 needed in 42.
Two! Fifty for Rizwan! The golden duck is followed by a half ton and one under pressure. This is on middle, it is worked through mid-wicket. Two taken.
FOUR! Innovation and it comes off! Rizwan goes down on one knee and then looks to play the paddle scoop. He hits it fine and past the keeper for another boundary.
Very full and on off, this is whipped down to long off for one.
A yorker on middle, it is jammed out to covers.
SIX! Right in the slot and Azam puts it away! On middle, Babar heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Once again the over starts with a boundary.
A yorker on off, Azam looks to jam it out. He gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
A single now as this is worked through square leg for one.
Miscue but safe! Luck not favoring the hosts right now! Length and on middle, Azam looks to heave it but it goes off the splice. Lands well short of long on for one.
Swing and a miss! Outside off, Azam looks to go but but misses.
FOUR! Too easy for South Africa at the moment! Azam walks across, this is a full toss on the pads. It is worked behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
A low full toss, this is whipped wide of mid-wicket. Two taken.
Two! Angled into the pads, this is worked through backward square leg for two.
Outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Direct hit and Azam was a goner! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled towards short fine leg. They go for a run. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end but misses.
On middle, it is worked towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Two! So six from the first two balls! Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for a couple.
FOUR! Stand and deliver stuff! This is fuller and on off, Azam stands tall and lofts it over the mid off fielder. Boundary. Good start to the over.
FOUR! That is a top class shot! Rizwan comes down the track and makes room. Lofts it over the cover fielder and bags a boundary. Pakistan on top at the halfway mark. 103 needed in the last 10.
Flatter and on off, Rizwan pushes it to covers.
Shorter and on middle, Azam pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
Slightly short, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Two now! On middle, it is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Lands safe! Azam looks to play the slog sweep but it is a little too full. He mistimes it towards the deep mid-wicket region. It land safe. One taken.
11 from the over then and end of Linde, not the best of nights for him! On middle, Azam works it towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Once again through the point region! Shorter and width on offer again. Azam hangs back and cuts it through point. Another boundary.
Rizwan now works it down to long on for one more. Good clever batting.
On middle, this is pushed past the bowler, down to long off for one.
Misses out this time! Shorter again, this is cut again but to point.
FOUR! Fifty for Azam! The skipper leading from the front in an important game! Only half the job done though! This is shorter and outside off, it is cut past point. Races away.
Just a single to end! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
In the gap yet again! Shorter and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. Wide of long on. Two.
Fuller and outside off, it is carved towards sweeper cover for one.
One more short one, this zips off the surface. Azam mistimes his pull down to long off for one.
Another drag down and it does not go the fence again! This is pulled towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep runs to his right and dives. Saves two.
In the gap! Shorter and outside off, Azam slaps it through covers. Two taken.
Shamsi is on! He needs to make an impact here. Can he do so?
Another single to end! On off, it is pushed down to long off for one.
A single this time, on middle, this is worked down to long on for a single.
A dot! The hosts need a lot more! On middle, defended.
Now smartly works this one through square leg for one.
FOUR! This is an outstanding shot. Just playing with the field there! This is not very short and there is not a lot of width on offer. Azam watches it carefully and gets it behind point. Boundary.
On off, this is pushed to long off for one.
Linde is back on!
On middle, it is pushed to mid on. A dot to end but the damage has been done earlier on in the over. Pakistan are 64 for 0 after 6. Top start for them. 140 needed in 14.
Shorter and on middle, it is a slower short ball, this is pulled through square leg for one.
SIX! 17 now with two balls to go! Top edge and it goes all the way! Shorter and on middle, Rizwan looks to pull but it goes off the top edge and over the fine leg fence.
A single now! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one. 11 from the first three balls.

FOUR! Majestic stuff! Showed power on the last ball and now a deft touch! On off, Azam plays it very late. He guides it past short third man who does dive to his left and get a hand to it but can't stop it.
SIX! Stand and deliver stuff! Fuller and on middle, Azam heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. The pressure that was built in this last over has been let off.
A dot to end a very good first by Williams! On middle, it is driven to mid on.
Just a single again! A low full toss on middle, this is worked to deep mid-wicket. Only one.
Two dots in a row! On middle, Azam plays it late, he plays it towards short third man.
Fuller and on off, this is stroked to covers.
Very well fielded! Saves two for his side! Shorter and outside off, this is cut towards point. The fielder there dives to his left and stops it, not cleanly but saves two.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
FOUR! Deft again! This is even better! This was closer to the off pole. Azam plays it late again and hits it past short third man. Boundary. 15 from this over and back-to-back big overs.
FOUR! Deft from Azam! Lets this one come to him. It is outside off, Azam guides it past point and it races away to the fence.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on for one. Good batting.
FOUR! Really nicely played! Lets the ball come to him, it is shorter and on the body, Rizwan pulls it behind square on the leg side. Races away.
Shorter and on middle, Azam looks to pull but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit to mid on for one.
A single to end but 16 from the over! Rizwan comes down the track and jams it out to mid on for one.

SIX! Nailed! That made a cracking sound of the bat! 15 from the over with a ball to go! Rizwan moves across again and this is on off. He smashes it over the mid-wicket fence. First biggie of the chase.
Angled into the pads, Azam looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. A single as it rolls on the off side.
FOUR! Fortunate boundary! Azam comes down the track again but this time Linde fires it, Azam yorks himself. He looks to jam it out but it goes off the underedge down to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! That is a good shot. Really good use of the feet! Steps out, gets to the pitch of it and hits it wide of mid on for a boundary.
Flatter and on middle, Azam makes room and slaps it to covers.
Two to end! Shorter and on middle, Rizwan heaves it. It goes off the splice and over mid-wicket for two.
Direct hit and Azam was a goner! He flicks this straight to mid-wicket and takes one.
A huge appeal but that has pitched outside leg. Rizwan looks to flick it but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the off side. A leg bye taken.
Goes full again, this is pushed to mid on.
Two again! On middle, Rizwan strokes it towards mid on. The fielder misfields again. One more.
Misfield and two! Very full and on off, this is stroked towards cover. Phehlukwayo lets it through his legs. Two taken.
Hendricks to bowl from the other end!
A tidy first from Linde! Shorter and around off, Azam cuts it to point.
Just another single! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Rizwan shuffles across, this is fired outside off. Defended.
Azam is off the mark now! Full, this is hit down to long off for one more.
Pakistan and Rizwan are off the mark! On middle, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Fuller and on off, Rizwan strokes it to covers.
